**1. Conflicting evidence**

- **Child-profile conflicts** (Helen's birthplace "Peru"; Orrin's birth year 1877 vs. 1878) are on child profiles and do not affect Edward's profile directly.

- Death on 16 Aug 1913 at Burlington is corroborated by five independent sources — the strongest support in this profile.

|---|---|

| Mary and Caroline (children) | No attached source for either child |
| Clarissa's death (1881) | Unsourced on this profile |
| Burial date | No source gives a date |

**4. Overall assessment**

The profile is **moderately well supported** for identity, parentage, death date, death place, and paternity of most children. The key weaknesses are:
- The exact birth date is unsourced and contradicted by Find a Grave.
- Both marriages lack any marriage record.
- Two early children (Mary and Caroline) have no sources.
- Three indexes transcribe the father's name inconsistently, suggesting transcription errors that should be resolved against the original images.

---

## Sources Audited: 7 attached — 2 findings, 1 conflict routed, 4 clear

---

### ⚠️ Finding 1 — Indexing Error (Year)
**Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621–1968** — marriage entry  
The index shows **9 June 1845** at St. Patrick's, Sherbrooke; the profile records **9 June 1849**. The day, month, parish, and spouse (Margaret Hayes) all match — only the year differs by four years. This is a single-field indexing error.  
**Action:** Re-read the marriage register page image in this collection and correct the indexed year to what the register shows. Keep the source attached.

---

### ⚠️ Finding 2 — Indexing Error (Place, unconfirmed kind)
**Census of Canada East, 1851**  
The index gives residence as **Melbourne, Canada East**; the profile records **Sherbrooke**. The entry contains only a name and Irish birthplace — no age, spouse, or household — so it's unclear whether the place was mis-keyed or this is a different person entirely.  
**Action:** Re-read the original 1851 enumeration return for this entry. Do not detach the source yet; a re-read will confirm mis-keyed place vs. misattribution.

---

### ⚡ Conflict Routed (Not a Profile Error)
Two sources disagree about the **death/burial**:
- **Quebec Catholic Parish Registers — burial:** 14 April 1878, St. Patrick's Cemetery
- **Quebec Civil Registration Deaths, 1867–1900:** death 2 February 1885, Sherbrooke

The profile carries no death date, so neither disagrees with a recorded fact — they disagree with *each other*. This pair should go to the **conflict-resolution** workflow before a death date is added to the profile.

---

### ✅ Sources Checked and Clear
| Source | Key Facts | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Ireland Catholic Parish Registers | Christening 12 Mar 1814, Skibbereen | Agrees with profile birth year 1814 |
| Quebec burial register (DRIS-003) | Burial at St. Patrick's Cemetery | Agrees with profile burial place |
| Census of Canada, 1861 | Residence Sherbrooke; birth year ~1816 | Agrees (1816 is within normal census variance) |
| Quebec Civil Registration Deaths (DRIS-004) | Birth 1814, Ireland | Agrees |

---

### 🔍 Could Not Check
The **headstone photograph** (uploaded memory, St. Patrick's Cemetery) is an image with no readable record ID and was not read. It cannot settle the burial/death conflict without a re-read.

---

### Note
An implausible-place warning exists on the project tree: at least one place on this person is not linked to a standard FamilySearch place. This was flagged but is separate from the source audit.

This audit has been logged as **log_001** in the project's research log.

Here is what the source-evaluation agent found on **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)**, ranked worst first:

---

### Finding 1 — Misattributed source (worst)
**"Minnesota State Census, 1885"** (HOLE-003)  
The index entry is for a *different* Christian Hole: born 1852 in Norway, residing in **Aurdal, Otter Tail County**, with wife Bergit and son Nils. This profile's subject was born 1875, lived in **Polk County**, and had wife Inger and son Ole C. — the household is a completely different family.  
The same record is already correctly attached to **KD96-WX7** (the 1852-born Christian Hole who died in Aurdal in 1919).  
**Action:** Detach this record from Christian P. Hole's sources — it belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

### Finding 2 — Indexing error or possible misattribution (needs verification)
**"Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002"** (HOLE-002)  
The index gives a death year of **1954**; the profile records **1945**. Name and birthplace agree. Because it's an index-only collection with no image, it's unclear whether this is a transcription error or a second Christian P. Hole who died in 1954.  
**Action:** Obtain and read the original death certificate for the Erskine, Polk County death to determine the correct year before deciding whether to detach.

---

### Gaps (not errors, but noted)
- **Marriage has no attached source.**
- **No sources cover residences 1910–1930.**
- A "Hole family photograph and funeral card" memory item cites a 1945 death in Erskine but has no readable record ID — treat as a lead only.

---

### Not counted as a finding
The 1900 census (HOLE-001) gives birth year 1877 vs. the profile's 1875 — normal census drift; household and place agree.

The findings have been logged as **log_001** in the project's research.json.

Here is the source-evaluation agent's full report on Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2):

---

**Sources reviewed: 4 attached — 2 findings**

---

### Finding 1 — Indexing error (keep attached, correct the index)
**Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002**
The indexed death *year* is 1954, but the profile records 1945. The name, place (Erskine, Polk County), day/month (10 June), and birth year (1875, Norway) all agree — only the year differs. This looks like a mis-keyed index entry rather than a different person.
- **Action:** Re-read the original death certificate or register the index is derived from. If it reads 1945, submit a correction through FamilySearch's index-correction path. **Do not detach.**

---

### Finding 2 — Misattributed source (detach)
**Minnesota State Census, 1885** (indexed as "Christian Hole")
This record shows: born **1852** Norway, residence in **Aurdal, Otter Tail County**, with wife Bergit and son Nils. The profile has Christian P. Hole born **1875**, residing in **Polk County** — the birth years are 23 years apart, the county differs, and none of the household members match.

The same source is already attached to **KD96-WX7** (another Christian Hole, born 1852, Otter Tail County, died 1919 Aurdal), where it fits perfectly.
- **Action:** **Detach this source from KD96-TV2.** Confirm it on KD96-WX7 instead.

---

### No finding — 1900 US Census (keep attached)
The 1900 census (Fairview Township, Polk) matches the profile's residence, household members (Inger, Ole C.), and place. The birth year reads 1877 vs. the profile's 1875, which is normal census variance.

---

### Could not audit — Funeral card/family photograph (uploaded memory)
No readable record ID. The citation names a 1945 funeral card from Erskine — worth reviewing as a lead on the death-year discrepancy in Finding 1, but cannot be audited as a standard record.

---

### Sourcing gap (noted, not a finding)
The 1 May 1898 **marriage** has no attached source. Worth adding one when records are found.

---

**Bottom line:** Two of the four sources need action — detach the 1885 Otter Tail census (it belongs to a different Christian Hole), and re-read the original death document before correcting or accepting the 1954 index year.

The audit has been logged to `research.json` as **log_001**.

Here is the source-evaluation audit for **Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)** — 4 sources attached, 2 actionable findings:

---

## ✅ Sources That Check Out

- **United States Census, 1900** — Good. Residence in Fairview, Polk, Minnesota fits the profile. The two-year birth year variance (1877 vs. 1875) is ordinary census drift.
- **Hole family photograph and funeral card (uploaded memory)** — Could not be read directly (uploaded image, no record ID). The 1945 funeral card noted in its citation is worth comparing once you check the death record below.

## ⚠️ Finding 1: Indexing Error — Minnesota Death Index

**Record:** Minnesota Death Index, 1908–2002  
**Problem:** The index shows a death date of **10 June 1954**, but the profile records **10 June 1945**. All other fields (name, birth year 1875, Norway, Erskine, Polk) match the profile — only the death *year* differs.  
**Action:** This is likely a transcription error in the index, not a different person. Re-read the original death certificate or state death register this index derives from. If the certificate shows 1945, submit a correction through FamilySearch's correction path. **Keep the source attached.**

---

## Sources on Cornelius Driscoll (GJ72-9WD) — Audit Results

7 sources attached; 3 findings, ranked worst first.

---

### Finding 1 — Source-vs-Source Conflict *(most serious)*
**Two records give different death dates — both cannot be right.**

- **Quebec, Catholic Parish Registers (burial):** burial 14 April 1878, St. Patrick's Cemetery, Sherbrooke
- **Quebec, Civil Registration Deaths, 1867–1900:** death 2 February 1885, Sherbrooke

Both name a Cornelius Driscoll born 1814 in Ireland at Sherbrooke, so they appear to describe the same man. No winner can be declared here.

**→ Route to conflict-resolution** to determine which death date is correct.

---

### Finding 2 — Indexing/Transcription Error (year of marriage)
**Quebec, Vital and Church Records (Drouin Collection), 1621–1968**

- Indexed year: 1845 — Profile year: 1849 (same day, month, couple, and place)
- One year is wrong; the original register image should be re-read to determine which.
- **Keep the source attached** until the original is verified.

---

### Finding 3 — Ambiguous Attachment (1851 census residence)
**Census of Canada East, 1851**

- Indexed place: Melbourne, Canada East — Profile place: Sherbrooke, Canada East
- No age, spouse, or household members are indexed, so the match cannot be confirmed without reading the original enumeration.
- **Do not detach** until the original is read.

---

### Precision Note (not a finding)
The **Ireland, Catholic Parish Registers** christening entry gives **12 March 1814** at Skibbereen, Cork, Ireland — this refines the profile's undated "1814, Ireland" and may be adopted if you agree.

---

### Could Not Fully Check
An **uploaded headstone photograph** (St. Patrick's Cemetery memory) has no readable record ID or date in its citation. It is a lead, not stand-alone evidence — examine the headstone itself to see what date it shows (potentially helpful for resolving Finding 1).

---

## Sources Audit — Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2)

The indexed death year is **1954**, but the profile records **1945** (10 June). The name, place (Erskine, Polk, Minnesota), and 1875 Norway birth all match — only the year differs. This record belongs to Christian P. Hole, but has one bad field.

**Next step:** Obtain the actual death certificate to read the year. If it confirms 1945, submit a correction to the FamilySearch index. **Keep the source attached** — it is good evidence with one wrong field.

---

### Finding 2 — Minnesota State Census, 1885 · **Misattributed**
This record shows a Christian Hole born **1852** in Norway, living in **Aurdal, Otter Tail County**, with wife Bergit and son Nils. The profile records a birth of **1875** in **Polk County** — birth year, county, and household all disagree across multiple fields. The record also appears attached to profile **KD96-WX7** (Christian Hole, b. 1852, Aurdal, Otter Tail, d. 1919), whose facts fit perfectly.

**Next step:** **Detach this record from KD96-TV2.** It belongs to KD96-WX7.

---

The project tree flags a contradiction: a Residence event dated **1950** falls after the death date of **1945-06-10**. This may be a data-entry error worth reviewing.

---

1. Pull the death certificate; correct the 1954/1945 year in the Death Index if the certificate confirms 1945.

## Source Audit — 7 Sources Reviewed

### ✅ 2 User-Actionable Findings

- The index gives residence as **Melbourne, Canada East**; the profile records **Sherbrooke, Canada East**. No age or birth year in the record to independently confirm the person.
- **Action:** Re-read the enumeration entry to confirm whether the household is in Melbourne or Sherbrooke before deciding whether to detach.

Two death records cannot both be right:
- **Quebec Catholic Parish Registers** — burial **14 April 1878**, St. Patrick's Cemetery
- **Quebec Civil Registration Deaths** — death **2 February 1885**, Sherbrooke

Both are exact-date records for the same name and birthplace. The profile holds no death date, so neither contradicts the profile directly, but they contradict each other. This should go to a **conflict-resolution** review.

---

- **Ireland Catholic Parish Registers** christening (12 March 1814, Skibbereen) — agrees with the 1814 birth year on the profile; refines rather than contradicts.

- Spouse name forms are consistent throughout.

---

### ℹ️ Could Not Check

- An **uploaded headstone photograph** (St. Patrick's Cemetery) has no record ARK and its image could not be read. It may be useful evidence for resolving the 1878 vs. 1885 death question.

---

### Tree Note
One place on this person is not linked to a standard/recognized place (flagged as nonStandardPlace). Worth reviewing the place fields.

---

The 1885 census misattribution correctly identifies birth 1852 vs. profile 1875, wife Bergit vs. Inger, son Nils vs. Ole C., and Otter Tail vs. Polk county — all from the HOLE-003 record_read response.
